question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

To throw cold water on

options.text: To be discouraging or unenthusiastic about something
To make someone see the truth

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"To throw cold water on"** means** to be discouraging or unenthusiastic about something.** (किसी चीज़ के प्रति निरुत्साही या हतोत्साहित होना)

 
 
• **Example: **She threw** cold water on** his plans to start a new business.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To elevate someone's plans** (किसी की योजनाओं को प्रोत्साहित करना): To uplift or promote someone's plans.

 
 
• **Example:** The mentor elevated his plans by providing valuable advice and resources.
 
 
 
• **To awake someone** (किसी को जगाना): To wake someone up from sleep or make them aware of something.
 
 
• **Example: **She tried to awake him early in the morning for the exercise session.
 
 
 
• **To make someone see the truth** (किसी को सच्चाई दिखाना): To help someone understand or realize the reality.
 
 
• **Example:** He finally made her see the truth about the company's financial status.
 
 

30:Te89,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
